summary: Frontend regression testing for Memory Archive after replacement of whileInView scroll-triggered animations with on-load setTimeout-driven staggered animations. Verified WITHOUT any scrolling that Chapter 01/02/03, Score, and Apology stages animate elements to opacity=1 on mount. Ran full 16-step journey Boot -> Intro -> Ch01 -> Ch02 -> Ch03 -> Score -> transition-lost -> Apology -> Final -> Unlock. Also verified dark 'sticker note' visual style (bg rgb(74,59,44), light cream text) on intro, Ch01 and Ch02.

chapter_01_no_scroll.note: Lines stagger ~0.75s apart as expected; all reach opacity 1 without any scroll interaction
chapter_01_no_scroll.confession_typewriter: Rendered and completed (sub text 'The photos from last year...' and 'in my defence, I have no defence.' sticker visible; confession-cta reachable and clickable)

chapter_02_no_scroll.photo-0_tap_reveals_caption: photo-0-caption testid not present in DOM (caption may use different selector or render inline)

chapter_03.yes_button_force_click: worked (NO dodges on hover as expected)

score_stage.note: Individual counter data-testids not exposed; counters populated final values visible in text without scrolling

apology_stage.note: Individual apology-line testids not exposed; stage container animates cleanly to opacity 1

sticker_notes_dark_style.verdict: PASS - all three dark stickers verified with correct computed background & light text

detailed_verifications.full_journey: Boot -> Intro -> Chapter01 -> transition -> Chapter02 -> transition -> Chapter03 (form + swipe + yes/no + earn) -> Score -> stage-quiet(transition-lost auto) -> chapter-opener-04 -> Apology -> stage-final (final-choice yes/no) -> unlock/restart. All auto transitions advance. No stalled stages observed.

critical_code_review_comments: photo-0 caption element lacks a discoverable data-testid (expected 'photo-0-caption'); if this exists in Chapter02 it should be tagged for testability.

Individual score counter rows (apology/regret/composure) and apology-line-N elements have no data-testids - hard to verify per-row animation timing programmatically. Consider adding score-row-{key} and apology-line-{i} testids.
stage-final yes/no reuses generic 'yes-button'/'no-button' testids also present in Chapter03; if both stages ever mount concurrently this could cause selector collisions.

Sticker notes: consistent dark-note style is applied via inline styles across three different files - consider consolidating into the StickerNote component (ui.jsx) with a `tone='dark'` variant to prevent divergence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix from iteration_2 (replacing whileInView with on-mount setTimeout stagger) is verified: all key elements reach opacity 1 with scrollY=0. Selectors that don't exist in DOM (and thus were not verifiable): photo-0-caption, per-counter rows in score, individual apology-line-*. Mobile viewport hides 'this took a while' + Ch02 aside via `hidden sm:block`/`hidden md:inline-block` (intentional). Force-click yes-button in Ch03 & stage-final because MovingNoButton dodges on mouseenter.
rca of the issue: Prior bug: whileInView animations never fired for elements below the initial fold because framer-motion intersection observers required the user to scroll. Fix (verified): Chapter01/02/03, Stages.jsx (Score, Apology), PhotoReveal.jsx now use animate + transition.delay with setTimeout-based Counter, so animations begin on mount regardless of scroll position. Verified by asserting opacity=1 on all target testids while window.scrollY remained 0.
